name: Galactic East
source:
Kayla Fielding knew she wanted to see the stars since before she even knew she was a girl. It's why she was so eager to hop on a cryogenic sleeper ship from Earth to build a home with like minded colonists among the stars.

In some ways, her dream came true as she now lives and works hundreds of light years from Earth in the  far flung Eastpoint star cluster, a home to multiple inhabited planets and a trio of sapient alien species all mostly getting along and more than willing to accept a "blessed" one such as herself...

But she didn't expect to be working as a "Sister" in an alien religion.

She didn't expect to be burying over 20,000 victims of an interstellar disaster.

And she definitely didn't expect someone would be trying to kill her...

[From [url=https://metalink345.itch.io/galactic-east]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯拉·菲尔丁在知道自己是个女孩之前就知道自己想看星星。这就是为什么她如此渴望从地球跳上一艘低温卧铺船，与志同道合的殖民者在星际中建立家园。

在某种程度上，她的梦想成真了，因为她现在在距离地球数百光年的遥远的东点星团中生活和工作，这里是多个有人居住的行星和三个外星智慧物种的家园，所有人都相处得很好，并且非常愿意接受像她这样的“有福的”物种……

但没想到，她竟然在外教里当“修女”。

她没想到会埋葬超过20,000名星际灾难的遇难者。

她万万没想到，竟然有人想杀她……

[来自[url=https://metalink345.itch.io/galactic-east]Itch.io[/url]]
